# 🌄 Munnar — 4‑Day Trip  
> **Bengaluru → Munnar** · 10 Dec 2026 – 13 Dec 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹35,000 · Estimated total ₹17,600  

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** Volvo AC sleeper bus, ₹1,100 pp, 9 h 05 m  
- **Stay:** **Blue Bells Resort** – ₹2,600 / night, 3★, breakfast included, book on Booking.com  
- **Weather:** 12‑15 °C, misty mornings, clear evenings – light woollens & rain‑coat recommended  
- **Total cost:** ₹17,600 of ₹35,000 budget (₹17,400 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** RedBus Volvo AC Sleeper, Bus # BGL‑V101, ₹1,100 pp, dep 4:30 PM Bengaluru → arr 1:35 AM Munnar (next day)  
- **Return:** Same operator, Bus # BGL‑V102, dep 8:00 PM Munnar → arr 5:05 AM Bengaluru (next day)  
- **Why this option:** Direct overnight service saves a night of accommodation and avoids pricey flights; comfortable seats & blankets keep you warm in December.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Blue Bells Resort** — ₹2,600 / night · 3★ · Breakfast + Wi‑Fi · book on Booking.com  
2. **Eden Holidays** — ₹2,750 / night · 3★ · Breakfast + garden view · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Zenha Resorts** — ₹2,900 / night · 3★ · Breakfast + pool access · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Thu, 10 Dec · Journey & Arrival
- **4:30 PM** — Board Volvo AC sleeper bus at **Bangalore KSRTC Bus Stand** (9 h 05 m travel)  
- **1:35 AM** (Fri) — Arrive at **Munnar Bus Stand**, take **auto‑rickshaw** (5 km, 15 min, ₹150) to hotel, check‑in, freshen up  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at **Blue Bells Resort** (included)  
- **9:30 AM** — Stroll around **Munnar town market** – shop for spices, tea packets (free)  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **Sree Mahaveer Restaurant** — Kerala Sadya thali, ₹150 pp  
- **2:00 PM** — Visit **KDHP Tea Museum** – entry ₹50 pp, tea tasting included  
- **4:30 PM** — Return to hotel, relax  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Taste The Brews Grills** — Grilled fish & appam, ₹200 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry a small power bank; many hill‑top spots have limited charging points.

### Day 2 — Fri, 11 Dec · Tea Gardens & Lakes
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **9:00 AM** — Depart by **shared taxi** to **Lockhart Tea Estate** (12 km, 30 min, ₹300 total) – plantation walk, photo ops (free)  
- **11:30 AM** — Head to **Mattupetty Dam** (8 km, 20 min, ₹200) – boat ride optional (₹250 pp)  
- **1:00 PM** — Lunch at **Shri Lakshmi Tiffin Corner** — Chicken fry & parotta, ₹120 pp  
- **2:30 PM** — Visit **Echo Point** (2 km, 10 min, ₹100 auto) – short hike, great views (free)  
- **4:30 PM** — Return to hotel, tea tasting session at resort (free)  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Corner Café & Bakery** — Malabar parotta with beef curry, ₹150 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Wear sturdy shoes for the dam walk; the path can be slippery.

### Day 3 — Sat, 12 Dec · Wildlife & Panorama
- **7:30 AM** — Early breakfast (included)  
- **8:30 AM** — Depart by **private cab** to **Eravikulam National Park** (15 km, 40 min, ₹500 total) – entry ₹300 pp, spot Nilgiri Tahr  
- **11:30 AM** — Drive to **Top Station** (10 km, 25 min, ₹300) – tea garden vistas, photo stop (free)  
- **1:00 PM** — Picnic lunch (packed from hotel, ₹200 pp) at Top Station lawn  
- **2:30 PM** — Return via **Kundala Lake** – optional pedal‑boat (₹150 pp)  
- **4:30 PM** — Back to hotel, relax in the lounge  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Rapsy Restaurant** — Kerala fish curry, rice, ₹180 pp  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry a binocular for wildlife spotting; park entry permits are limited, so arrive early.

### Day 4 — Sun, 13 Dec · Local Flavors & Return
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast (included) & checkout (store luggage at reception)  
- **9:30 AM** — Visit **Munnar Spice Plantation** (5 km, 15 min, ₹200) – guided walk, spice tasting (free)  
- **11:30 AM** — Lunch at **Saravana Bakers** — Appam & stew, ₹130 pp  
- **1:00 PM** — Return to hotel, collect luggage  
- **2:00 PM** — Auto‑rickshaw to **Munnar Bus Stand** (5 km, 15 min, ₹150)  
- **8:00 PM** — Board Volvo AC sleeper bus back to Bengaluru (9 h 05 m)  
- **5:05 AM** (Mon) — Arrive Bengaluru, end of trip  
- 💡 *Tip:* Keep your bus ticket handy; night buses sometimes change platform.

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Kerala Sadya** at **Sree Mahaveer Restaurant** — ₹150 pp  
- **Appam & Stew** at **Rapsy Restaurant** — ₹180 pp  
- **Malabar Parotta with Beef Curry** at **Corner Café** — ₹150 pp  
- **Fresh Cardamom Tea** at any tea estate — ₹50 pp  
- **Kothu Parotta** from Munnar night market — ₹120 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (bus round‑trip) | ₹2,200 |
| Stay (3 nights) | ₹7,800 |
| Food (4 days × 2 people) | ₹2,400 |
| Local travel + activities | ₹3,000 |
| Buffer | ₹2,200 |
| **Total** | **₹17,600** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Daytime 12‑15 °C, evenings 8‑10 °C – pack light woollens & a warm jacket.  
- Light rain possible – carry a compact rain‑coat or poncho.  
- Good walking shoes, sunscreen, and a reusable water bottle.

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – Munnar Main Road  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump – near Munnar Bus Stand (≈2 km)  
- **Hospital:** Govt. Hospital, Munnar – Aluva‑Munnar Road, phone 0485‑236 1234  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Munnar Bus Stand (KSRTC) – main arrival/departure point  

## 💡 Local tips
- Book the **Eravikulam NP** entry online (if possible) to avoid long queues.  
- Carry cash; many small eateries accept only cash.  
- Respect tea‑garden rules – no littering, stay on marked paths.  
- Light woolens are essential; mornings are chilly even in December.  
- Keep a copy of your bus ticket and hotel confirmation on your phone.
